segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הָעוֹבֵר לִפְנֵי הַתֵּיבָה בְּיוֹם טוֹב שֶׁל רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה, הַשֵּׁנִי מַתְקִיעַ. וּבִשְׁעַת הַהַלֵּל, הָרִאשׁוֹן מַקְרֵא אֶת הַהַלֵּל.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to «one who is passing before the ark,» as prayer leader, «on the festival of Rosh HaShana,» it is «the second» prayer leader, i.e., the one who leads the additional prayer, who «sounds» the shofar on behalf of the congregation. «And» on a day «when the hallel» is recited, «the first» prayer leader, i.e., the one who leads the morning prayer, «recites the hallel» on behalf of the congregation.

moves.cueHe: העובר לפני התיבה ביום טוב של ראש השנה
moves.summary: second leader sounds the shofar; first leads hallel

positions.claim: the second prayer leader sounds the shofar; the first recites hallel
